sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve all prior conditional-marking instructions. Repair applicability: the post-cutoff and pre-cutoff marking alternatives must not make warningTrianglePresent, iceClassDraughtMarkPresent, or the amidships mark mandatory when summerLoadLineFreshWaterDraught is not greater than upperIceWaterlineDraught; the current direction SPARQL instead rejects that non-applicable case, and the pre-cutoff alternatives require markings or a docking date regardless of direction. Put the draught-direction condition into the marking applicability logic, while retaining complete-marking evidence with certificate amidships equality.
